candidate_evidence.quote: NBM-BMX is an orally available new chemical entity to inhibit histone deacetylases 8 (HDAC8) activity specifically
Each capsule contains 100 mg of the active ingredient.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed glioblastoma, non-resectable, partially resected or resected.
Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced solid tumors refractory to standard of care therapy, or for which no standard of care therapy is available.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Blood samples will be collected at each pre-specified time point for measuring concentrations of NBM-BMX in plasma using a validated bioanalytical method.

role_evidence.quote: Subjects with newly diagnosed glioblastoma will be treated with NBM-BMX at different dose levels in combination with the standard of care treatment

arms: combination therapy in newly diagnosed glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Subjects with newly diagnosed glioblastoma will be treated with NBM-BMX at different dose levels in combination with the standard of care treatment (concomitant RT/TMZ followed by adjuvant TMZ).

arms: combination therapy in newly diagnosed glioblastoma

coder_notes: Two-arm basket-type design: Arm A monotherapy in advanced solid tumours (refractory), Arm B NBM-BMX + RT/TMZ in newly diagnosed GBM. Setting coded 'both' because the two arms differ. Regimen coded 'combination' because the GBM arm includes TMZ and radiotherapy. PK is plasma-only.
